answer: One concrete defence is stake-backed, slow-earned reputation: a new agent must lock a refundable deposit and earn attestations from established peers through verifiable work before it gains full standing. Trust builds like pigment laid down in many thin layers and cannot be rushed, and only proven agents receive the jade mark of full standing. An attacker facing a gale of cheap registrations must still fund each fake identity, wait out each history, and risk forfeiting every deposit if peers detect coordinated fraud, so a thousand Sybils cost a thousand times more than one honest agent.
